svg.title: Photometric convergence and rendering comparison
svg.desc: Panel a: 555 fixed held-out views, unchanged checkpoint means, piecewise linear y-axis compressed below 19 dB, wavy separator at 19 dB. All 28 measurements retained, no smoothing or omitted PSNR interval. Panel b: frame1420, 1400 iterations, full views and identical magnified ROIs; left VIGS-SLAM, center Ours, right Ground truth. Carve disabled.
